name: Free Speech
overview: Scripture teaches that free speech carries both responsibility and the call to defend justice and the vulnerable. Believers are urged to judge righteously and speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring fairness and protection (Deuteronomy 1:16; Proverbs 31:8). While we must bless rather than curse others, we are also warned to be careful with our words, as every idle word will be accounted for on the day of judgment (Psalms 109:28; Matthew 12:36). Additionally, the believer is called to exercise discernment, welcoming those weak in faith without engaging in divisive disputes (Romans 14:1) and not giving undue attention to harmful speech (Ecclesiastes 7:21).
